question: Which team had the highest map win rate in 2024, among teams with at least 30 maps?
sql:
WITH team_map_results AS (
    SELECT team_a_id AS team_id, winner_team_id FROM fact_map_result WHERE year = 2024 AND team_a_id IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT team_b_id AS team_id, winner_team_id FROM fact_map_result WHERE year = 2024 AND team_b_id IS NOT NULL
),
team_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        t.team_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.match_map_id) AS maps_played,
        SUM(CASE WHEN r.winner_team_id = t.team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS maps_won
    FROM team_map_results r
    JOIN fact_map_result m ON r.match_map_id = m.match_map_id
    JOIN dim_team t ON r.team_id = t.team_id
    WHERE m.year = 2024
    GROUP BY t.team_name
)
SELECT 
    team_name,
    maps_played,
    maps_won,
    ROUND(100.0 * maps_won / maps_played, 1) AS map_win_rate_pct
FROM team_stats
WHERE maps_played >= 30
ORDER BY map_win_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;
